definitions: A comprehensive and expertly designed set of instructions or questions intended to guide users in preparing for an examination.
A sophisticated prompt engineering technique specifically crafted to optimize study and review processes for test-takers.
examples: The instructor provided an Exam-Prep Master Prompt to help students focus their studies.
Using the Exam-Prep Master Prompt significantly improved my revision efficiency.
Developing an effective Exam-Prep Master Prompt requires deep understanding of the exam's structure.
